description: Header file defining a template class CountingAllocator for custom memory allocation tracking, used within the Abseil C++ library.

classes.name: CountingAllocator
classes.description: A stateful allocator template that tracks memory usage and instance count, with custom allocate, deallocate, construct, and destroy methods.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory for n objects of type T and updates bytes_used if applicable.

methods.name: deallocate
methods.description: Deallocates memory for n objects and updates bytes_used if applicable.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Constructs an object of type U at pointer p with forwarded arguments, increments instance count.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys an object of type U at pointer p, decrements instance count.
